claims.statement: A FORMAL_PROVED claim is accepted by the finite Lean model only with status PROVED.
claims.boundary: This is a typing property of the encoded model, not a truth proof for arbitrary prose.

claims.statement: An OPEN claim is accepted by the finite Lean model only with status OPEN.
claims.boundary: The theorem prevents status inflation inside the model.

claims.statement: Appending a finite delta preserves membership of every object already present in a corpus.
claims.boundary: The conclusion assumes the modeled append-only operator.

claims.statement: Content-object set-union is commutative by membership.
claims.boundary: This says nothing about truth or delivery.

claims.statement: Content-object set-union is associative.
claims.boundary: The theorem applies to the encoded finite object set.

claims.statement: Content-object set-union is idempotent by membership.
claims.boundary: Duplicate delivery is harmless only at this object-set layer.

claims.statement: Two replicas with the same corpus converge after receiving the same finite updates under the modeled merge.
claims.boundary: Eventual delivery and equal policies are external assumptions.

claims.statement: Evidence closure is monotone under append-only corpus extension.
claims.boundary: Later evidence may contest a conclusion but does not erase its historical derivation.

claims.statement: Answerability through an already evidence-closed path is monotone under append-only extension.
claims.boundary: The theorem does not claim that every question has such a path.

claims.statement: The empty corpus answers no query in the encoded model.
claims.boundary: This is a counterexample to structural total-answer claims.

claims.statement: Exact-statement novelty is corpus-relative and therefore does not establish global scientific novelty.
claims.boundary: Semantic equivalence and worldwide priority require separate review.

claims.statement: An explicit conflict remains present after append-only extension.
claims.boundary: A later disposition may govern use but cannot rewrite history.

claims.statement: The encoded qualified-observation predicate is true exactly when all eight declared gates are true.
claims.boundary: Adequacy of the chosen eight gates for a concrete instrument remains domain-specific.

claims.statement: Causal attribution in the encoded model requires an explicit intervention or identification strategy.
claims.boundary: The model does not itself validate a physical identification strategy.

claims.statement: An identical event trace can coexist with different physical-causation labels, so trace identity alone does not determine physical cause.
claims.boundary: This is a finite countermodel, not an experimental physics result.

claims.statement: Modeled digital-twin actuation requires a qualified observation.
claims.boundary: Concrete plant safety requires separate validation.

claims.statement: Modeled digital-twin actuation requires a completed effect acknowledgement.
claims.boundary: The theorem specifies a gate; it does not grant an effect authorization.

claims.statement: Every encoded finite message list can be split into singleton segments and reconstructed exactly by flattening.
claims.boundary: Noise, loss, timing and channel capacity are not modeled by this theorem.

claims.statement: Appending a suffix preserves the original finite list as a prefix.
claims.boundary: The result assumes no mutating side path.

claims.statement: Prefix relations are transitive in the encoded finite-list model.
claims.boundary: This is a structural property of lists.

claims.statement: A proposal-only analysis decision never authorizes an external effect.
claims.boundary: A separate owner-bound effect protocol remains necessary.

claims.statement: A QIK-VRT repository can be understood as a causality mirror when it binds observations, transformations, hypotheses, decisions, intended effects and observed effects without equating chronology with physical causation.
claims.boundary: This is an architectural interpretation.

claims.statement: Automated claim analysis shall fail closed, preserve conflicts and retain explicit uncertainty rather than promote plausible language to fact.
claims.boundary: This is a protocol requirement.

claims.statement: The source audio proposes successive cognitive improvement and a distributed searchable store of human knowledge through QIK-VRT mesh use.
claims.boundary: The audio is bound as provenance and does not prove its proposal.

claims.statement: QIK-VRT use improves the cognition of every user or cognitive system.
claims.boundary: This requires operational metrics, controls, preregistration and empirical replication.

claims.statement: A QIK-VRT mesh can contain the entirety of human knowledge and answer every conceivable question.
claims.boundary: Completeness is contradicted by finite coverage, unknown facts, underdetermination and undecidability.

claims.statement: Arbitrary natural-language statements can be translated into semantically faithful Lean theorems and proved without review.
claims.boundary: Parsing, meaning selection, premise choice and proof search remain incomplete and fallible.

claims.statement: The same evidence-envelope architecture can connect software events, sampled analog signals, controller decisions and digital-twin states when each domain supplies its own calibration and uncertainty semantics.
claims.boundary: Applicability is conditional; no concrete plant is validated here.

claims.statement: The repository model establishes a physical quantum-to-classical causal bridge or physical retrocausal communication.
claims.boundary: Neither the Lean model nor the virtual witness supplies the required physical experiment.

claims.statement: EU AI Act audit readiness requires traceable evidence and role-specific legal assessment; this publication is neither a conformity certificate nor legal advice.
claims.boundary: Applicable duties depend on role, system, risk class, deployment and current law.
